svg.title: The long-video context wall
svg.desc: At 1 fps and 256 tokens per frame: 1 s is 256 tokens, 10 s 2,560, 1 min 15,360, 10 min 153,600, 1 hour 921,600, far beyond a 128k context.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The context wall: even at 1 fps, an hour of video ≈ 920k tokens
